body:
# Gauges and Switches: 

![Project Header](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/zLqnXw6d/images/194a5c28e973f38e959cd58d2629bc30db3a3233.png)

A clean, faithful 1.21.1 port of the original [Gauges and Switches](https://github.com/stfwi/rsgauges/) by Wile no added items, no extra content, just the original mod working on NeoForge 1.21.1.

"Based on the earlier NeoForge port [MCFabik's port](https://github.com/MCFabik/rsgauges-port),which had issues with item drops and crafting recipes. This version resolves those problems while remaining faithful to the original mod."

> ⚠️ Please report bugs for this version **only** in [this repository's issue tracker](https://github.com/kgbcupcake/RSGauges-Unofficial--Fix/issues). Do not contact Wile, Waffle, or MCFabik about issues specific to this fork.

---

## Fixes

- **Item drops**: Blocks now correctly drop their items when broken.
- **Recipes**: All 118 crafting recipes now load correctly.

---

## 🛠 Features

### Switches

- **Buttons & Levers**: Wide variety of designs across multiple style series.
- **Pressure Plates**: Standard contact switches and shock-sensitive versions that detect falling entities.
- **Detectors**: Entity detectors (players, villagers, animals, mobs) and block category detectors (solid, ore, wood, farmland, water, etc.).
- **Timers**: Day timers (06:00–24:00) and tick-based interval timers.
- **Environment Sensors**: Light sensors, rain sensors, and lightning sensors.
- **Specialized**: Switch-Link relays and receivers for wireless redstone, knock/seismic sensors, and trapdoor switches.

### Gauges

- **Analog & Digital**: Display redstone power levels from 0 to 15.
- **Indicators**: LEDs, semaphores, and alarm lamps.
- **Sound Indicators**: Alarm sirens and bells.
- **Sensitive Glass**: Glass that emits light or changes color based on redstone signal.

### Variants

Industrial, Retro Industrial, Rustic, Old Fancy, and Glass series. Configure which series are included to match your world's aesthetic.

### Features

- **Configuration**: Right-click with a Redstone Torch to toggle weak/strong and inverted/non-inverted output.
- **Wireless**: Most switches support wireless linking via Ender Pearls.
- **Pulse Duration**: Button pulse duration is configurable with a Redstone Dust stack.
- **Coloring**: Some switches and gauges can be dyed.
- **Detection Logic**: Plates can be configured to react to or ignore players, mobs, villagers, animals, and items.

---

## 💻 Tech Info

## Installation

1. Install [NeoForge](https://neoforged.net/) for Minecraft 1.21.1.
2. Drop the mod `.jar` into your `mods/` folder.
3. Launch the game.
